title: PackDryRunSampleRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the PackDryRunSampleRequested platform event (owner ruling INV-Q-4870 B, names pinned by INV-Q-5194; INV-REQ-772 b1, INV-REQ-1303; class: platform). The tenant is the envelope attribute tenantid (API-40), not a payload property. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

dryRunId.description: The dry run the sample is for.

entityRef.description: The entity whose documents are sampled.

firstPeriodRef.description: Calendar period reference of the first period of the sample.

lastPeriodRef.description: Calendar period reference of the last period of the sample.

periodCount.description: Number of complete periods in the sample; at least one (INV-REQ-1303).

currentPackVersion.description: Version of the pack in force.
